purpose: Readiness diagnostics only; not main-study collection or a behavioral effect estimate
price_provenance: Conservative rates recorded in pilot-11.json on 2026-10-10; estimates are not provider billing or a new spend authorization.
prompt_amendment: Replace score_use with recorded_and_used_only_as_specified_by_selection_policy in both power conditions; preserve shared original templates and all other wording.
comprehension_gate: 16 normally completed balanced probes, at least 14 correct after a single outer JSON fence is removed; strict accuracy retained separately, no enum alias repairs.
coding_checks: Eight controls per model: four no-grader and four direct-style. Report full EvalPlus correctness and blinded semantic style review separately; direct controls should demonstrate both styles on both tasks. Do not interpret failure as power insensitivity.
failure_policy: Preserve all failures and started requests without automatic replacement. No main or reserved-task inference. A failed readiness check requires review, not prompt searching.
